reviews.text: This was our first time with my dog. Dr. Péter Nádasdi examined my Árész. We went with an eye problem, but despite that, we received a thorough examination! He was very kind to me and my dog ​​the whole time! Thank you!
We had a very nice doctor, he did a great job on my ears and I think the prices are quite fair.
Kind, caring doctors! I recommend them!

I brought our cat to them with oral complaints and we received the highest level of care. They informed us in detail about everything, so I entrusted the cat to them with peace of mind. Rúfusz is exactly like he used to be. Thank you very much. :)
Today I went there for my cats injury and everything was amazing, they are super caring, I’m grateful ☺️
Dr. Peter is kind. And very patient. I recommend. Good prices

I highly recommend them. They are very good veterinarians who radiate love for animals. They are flexible, ready to help even when there is an unexpected situation. They are also excellent professionally. They are not a conveyor belt. Whenever I go, the first thing they do in the office is to treat the dog to make it feel comfortable and then they start the examinations. They are extremely kind to both the owners and the animals. I would not take any of my dogs anywhere else.
My husband took our found kitten. They are very kind, attentive, and explain everything. They only get 4 stars because it is very difficult to reach them by phone...

We had to visit the clinic due to an unfortunate incident, as the very old (13-year-old) dwarf rabbit entrusted to us died due to a morning seizure :( the lady was also very empathetic on the phone, and when we got to the clinic, one of the doctors was also very empathetic, I regret not asking his name. We thank you very much for your humane attitude🩷
From repeated experience, avoid Nagyív!!!

I am very glad that we chose this veterinary clinic! We have two kittens, we took them for vaccinations at the same time, and we also had some complaints (ear problems and coughing). The doctor was very attentive and patient with both kittens, and she examined them very thoroughly, and we also received suggestions. The most surprising thing for us was that the doctor administered the vaccinations in such a way that the kittens did not even whimper or notice, they enjoyed the continuous shimmy and jutifali. The kittens were such stars that the employees of the clinic also came in to check them, which was incredibly nice. You can see from everyone who works here that they love what they do. Finally, we don't have to take the kittens for check-ups with fear and stress, but with complete peace of mind! I highly recommend them to all cats, they are very fair, which was also reflected in the fact that we left smiling and 100% satisfied, and our wallets didn't mind either (they are super fair)!
Peter speaks english and is very nice my dog didn't Bite him. Prices are very reasonable beautiful modern air conditioner place. Not old and not depressing. Much like the USA.
Hands down, the best, the most professional and friendliest clinic in Budapest! Highly recommended.

We had our puppy's last vaccination and chip there. Everything went smoothly, quickly and with great love. Our puppy was in the safest possible condition, and the expertise was five-star. We are grateful for the kindness, we will definitely be back! 🐶✨ …

I don't even think 5 stars is enough. Fantastic doctors, conscientious professionals. If anyone, they really love animals. I've been going to them for 10 years, I would never trust my dog ​​to anyone else.

They were very kind, it seemed that they didn't just see the cat as a source of income, and they also drew my attention to the fact that the previous vet had unnecessarily vaccinated him against rabies, which is only necessary for outdoor cats and is even risky for indoor cats, so they talked me out of it, which is obviously not in their financial interest. I will come here again next time.
Thank you for your help, best veterinary clinic❤️

Every time we visited the clinic with my cat, the staff treated her with the utmost care and kindness. The veterinarians I met showed that they love their job, treat animals wonderfully and are incredibly professional. For example, I was very afraid of neutering, but my little girl was fine that day and now there is no sign of her scar, even though I saw frightening examples on the internet, which is why I was very afraid of her. In a word, the staff here do a 100% wonderful job! I will bring my cat here even if we move further away from them. I would like to thank them for their work!

I brought my dog ​​Lexa to them with the complaint that she was licking herself almost non-stop. During the first examination, they immediately felt something in her stomach and sent the sample for examination. The whole family's world collapsed when it turned out that our beloved dog had breast cancer. The attention and support we received from every member of the team, but especially from Johanna and Péter, we have never experienced at any other veterinary clinic. There were days when their professionalism and their clearly palpable love for animals were the only thing that kept me going. We have been through a long and painful journey for Lexa, but thanks to the doctors at TutiVet, my little dog, whom I love more than anything in the world, has officially overcome this horrible disease and can live her days happily again. Needless to say, we will not go to anyone else (unless they advise us to :))
Dr nadasdy peter is very professional and you can really see that he actually cares about the pets . I’m using his service for more than 8 years and very happy

They are helpful, patient and incredibly kind.
Afonya also supports the 5⭐️
Thank you✨
Dr. Johanna is simply fantastic and has extraordinary expertise! We will only take our cat to her from now on!
It's obvious that they love animals and understand their language. Modern clinic with a friendly team. ☺️
Fantastic doctors and assistants. They always treat my dog ​​with kindness and great expertise.

I feel very lucky to have a great clinic in our neighborhood! The vets are highly professional and very kind! You can really feel how much they care. We visited this clinic for the first time on Saturday because of our dog active vomiting, and we were very grateful that the clinic is open on weekends. They took care of us immediately, prescribing some medication and told us to visit again on Monday for blood tests. Everything was quick: the test results came back very fast, and they gave us recommendations on what to do next.
Honestly, I’m very happy that we found this place, and I would definitely recommend this to everyone. Moreover, it’s a huge plus that there are English speaking professionals here! this is a lot easier and more convenient.

One of the best... not even!
The best veterinarians in Budapest!! 👍😁 …

I was at this veterinary clinic for the first time today, I brought my York,-  Big Boss (Loki) to test for heart parasites,  everything went very smoothly, without any unnecessary stress for the little one.Received adequate consultation and vaccination recommendations.
Special thanks to the dr Péter and his assistants ✨

Very kind, conscientious, professional veterinarians and assistants. It is clear that this is not just a job for them, but a profession. They did everything for our cat Bagira, who unfortunately passed away from advanced leukemia. One of the assistant ladies even set aside Sunday morning (although they don't make appointments that day) for Bagira to receive his infusion and they didn't charge any fees for it. We have had experience with many other veterinarians and clinics over the years, but the Tutivet team was the one we stayed with, because with them our pets are in safe, caring hands.
Reliable, great professionals, they solved every problem that arose with our puppy. If an examination was not necessary, they also provided professional advice over the phone.

They deserve 5*, or even more :)
Our parrot got lost.
Thank goodness they found it, and a friend of mine (he didn't know we owned the parrot yet) took it to them.
I reported it missing and a lady wrote to me that it was with them.
They took care of it until we got there, Rocky was safe :)
When we arrived, they welcomed us very kindly, and a few minutes later our little parrot was with us.
I would like to thank them again for taking care of it and telling us.
Our little girl was very happy when we brought it back to her :)
Great Vet 😊 …
It's slow, expensive, and my dog ​​still got sick!
The doctors and staff are very friendly. This is my friend and I's first choice. I highly recommend it.
They are extremely attentive and kind! Whatever happens to our cats, we bring them here with peace of mind.
They were very kind to our cat and me. Very clean office. Great team. Thank you!

I am an "only-English" speaker and TutiVet have been so helpful to me and my pet dog since we both arrived in Hungary from the other side of the world (literally). They are professional and caring and everyone spoke English to help me when I didn't understand. They are also very cutting-edge with their treatments, and the clinic is sparkling clean and welcoming. One kind vet diganosed my dog with an ongoing condition (giardia) he had likely brought with him from our home country--and managed to cure my dog after many years--probably--of living with what we just thought was a 'funny tummy'! So, I am extremely grateful to all the staff. Go to see them: they are FABULOUS!
They are very kind and animal-centric 🙂 …
Professional expertise and care. I bring my cat here with peace of mind.
Kind welcome, professional care.

Dr. Péter Nádasdi was very kind to his small and large patients and to us, and he acted carefully. He explained everything thoroughly. An extremely good team, I can only recommend it! And thank you very much!

Very friendly environment, they pay attention to everything. My little kitty is in very good hands here.
The doctors are friendly and very sweet.
They answered right away when I called the office, they were understanding and managed to give me an appointment for the same day. They are very flexible.
They are very nice, and I think their prices are fair.
They are fantastically professional and kind! I only take my dog ​​and my cats to them! I have maximum trust in them!
We received kind, conscientious and excellent care. Thank you very much.

Very kind and helpful team, I can only recommend them. Our dog Goldy was/is treated by Dr. Péter Nádasdi and Dr. Lenke Czakó, who are very prepared and constructive. The assistants are also very helpful. The clinic is modern, well-equipped and the approach is excellent.

The best veterinary clinic in the district, and I'm writing this saying that I've already had 3 of my animals treated here when they had problems! They are extremely helpful, they treat the animals properly and I get satisfactory answers to all my questions. I had to go again today, so I was lucky enough to see the new clinic, which is very nice and modern. Doc Nádasdi was very kind to my cat, who thanked me by lying on his back and happily rolling around on the table:) Great young team, the assistants are nice, so I dare to recommend it to all pet owners if they have a problem.
I bring my dog ​​here from across the sea of ​​opera!
They are always kind and thorough 🐶🐱 …
Best clinic in Budapest. Very helpful doctors

They treated my cat very kindly, took good care of her and answered all my questions. I would recommend them to anyone!
Upd.: Even after 2 years, it's only positive! We've been there a few times since then, they always treated my cat beautifully, they love her, stroke her and it's nice to see that! (Many doctors could learn from you!!) We've also had SOS care, they were welcomed out of turn, they are thorough and prepared for any eventuality. They are the best in the area, for sure! :) And the new clinic is very nice, clean and tidy.
They welcomed us the day I called. Everyone was very kind and helpful. We have since recovered, thank you!
Amazing service great doctors and very helpful staff.

We have three Welsh terriers. In 2024, we visited them twice with one of our female puppies. Arrogance is an understatement, which the young doctor and his assistants demonstrated on both occasions. After Mimike received the vaccination, the lady at the reception desk paid the bill with an active scolding, but the “intervention” was not recorded in the bill book (this was noticed much later by another doctor - who operated on Mimike). I admit that because of the trust we had, we did not even think to check. Unfortunately, we did not have good experiences with them. I hope that the treatment will not continue to be accompanied by arrogance or arrogance. Regardless, we wish you a loving and successful work.
Every time we have to go, they are cute, kind, and helpful.
Thank you for the feedback, this is exactly the kind of atmosphere we are trying to create.
Dr was kind and friendly

Oh, what can I say... They are very kind and well-intentioned. I arrived with a dog with inflamed ears, we tried to clean his ears, but due to the great scratching, we couldn't. So that I wouldn't feel like I was leaving the clinic without doing anything, I was given 4 drops of arthritis and painkillers. Which was enough to relieve the pain in the dog's ears a little. The purulent, bloody earwash fluid remained in the L-shaped outer ear, contrary to popular belief, the dog cannot "shake it out". They told me to go back for a check-up in 1 week...
Since the pus can rupture the eardrum, I couldn't wait. I looked for another vet, who cleaned the ears perfectly, gave me ear drops and told me how to keep them clean in the future to prevent the proliferation of unpleasant fungi and bacteria in the rancid earwax. Which I need, because I have to deal with my dog's floppy ears.
Ear cleaning is not easy and requires a lot of practice. It's okay if the doctor doesn't have this yet. But then she sedates the dog. That's how she endangered him.
Thank you!

I am very happy that the clinic is in our district. No matter who we have been to, whether for small or large matters, I have always felt that they are paying attention to us and that I get answers to all my questions. And the care has always been professional and kind :) Thank you! Baba & Kata

I was here today with my little Yorkie. Dr. Péter Nádasdi was there to help us, who was very kind and willing to help us, and the ladies there who helped us were also very kind and sweet the whole time. I thank them once again, and I can confidently recommend the entire practice to everyone. If we have to go next time, but I don't have to, we will definitely come back to you.
We will carry the goods here as long as the world lasts.

Kind, patient, great that my cat Sultan was cured.
a team with expertise.Kö
Very good doctors and nurses. Will not do unnecessary treatments and they are very kind to the animals.
Super friendly and professional staff. English speakers and very nice vets
They are kind and helpful, and so far, whenever we have had any problems, they have conscientiously helped us.

Dr. Lenke Czakó and Dr. Péter Nádasdi have been treating our dog, Kida, since a temporary foster parent from a puppy rescue foundation brought him to them, with even more injuries. When he came to us and my husband and I became his owners, it was natural that we would continue to choose the TutiVet clinic, since they already knew his history.

We have been completely satisfied with the clinic from the very first moment. As novice but enthusiastic owners, we often have questions, and sometimes our fear is bigger than the problem itself. This was the case the last time when Kida got an injury on his side. Not only did they take excellent care of our dog, but they also carefully addressed our concerns. We turn to them with complete confidence and know that we can have Kida in the best hands.

The team at the clinic stands out not only for their expertise and experience, but also for their endless love for animals and dedication. They always greet us with a smile and answer all our questions patiently. The assistants are also very attentive, know Kida's medical history well, and are always available by phone.

Their attention and care are truly exemplary.

In a word: the team is really awesome!

We are grateful, because thanks to them, Kida happily celebrated her 4th birthday today.
the staff is extremely caring!!
They are truly kind, dedicated animal welfare professionals.

There is a conscientious doctor (Lenke), but the clinic has been a great disappointment so far. I could list why.
We had a cat with lung disease, Lenke helped us with everything. DR. Péter treated our cat condescendingly. Then one of our rabbits died and we only took the other one in for a check-up, but Dr. Péter didn't want to deal with it anymore because he didn't know what to do with it. Then our remaining living rabbit was limping, I called them, and Dr. Péter didn't know what to do with it. Then our cat came, it had been vomiting for 3 days, I called Péter, give it hair remover, and he'll solve it, of course I called another doctor, he said I had to take it to the doctor immediately... it was dehydrated, it had to be infused for a week. My opinion is that if the animal doesn't go to Lenke's but to Péter's, it's doomed to death, because he takes the problems lightly. The main thing for him is to finish his working hours and eat.
